title: Wait-for graph: transaction nodes + 3 edge kinds
notes: IMPLEMENTED src/core/waitfor.c. Global edge list + spinlock, 3 edge kinds, contract abi 2 (struct tx_wait_edge, TX_IOC_WAIT/UNWAIT, TX_REASON_DEADLOCK). Both ends must be live transactions (-ESRCH) or the graph accumulates garbage that reads as a phantom deadlock.

title: Cycle detection on edge insert (coloured DFS)
notes: IMPLEMENTED. Detection runs INSIDE the ioctl, not on a timer. EDGE-SPECIFIC via path_back(): searching the whole graph meant an unresolvable cycle -- which never goes away -- poisoned every later insert with EDEADLK. Iterative DFS; recursive would be a stack overflow reachable from userspace.

title: Victim selection + abort; refuse to victimise DOOMED
notes: IMPLEMENTED. least-severe policy; a DOOMED transaction is never a candidate because DOOMED->ABORTING does not exist. Abort deferred to a workqueue (tx_do_abort sleeps, selection holds a spinlock). VERIFIED: victim aborted with reason=8 and the CoW layer actually discarded.

title: Report the all-DOOMED cycle instead of hanging
notes: IMPLEMENTED and VERIFIED end to end: the in-kernel classifier dooms two transactions, a cycle forms, and it CANNOT be broken -- EDEADLK to userspace with the reason. tests/p1/t11_waitfor.sh asserts no DOOMED tx is ever victimised.
